subject: ONE female spotted hyena, grey work shirt-apron, weary toothy grin; she/her
second_characters: ONE rat in a blue apron, envelope in paw
props: ONE thick tow rope; THREE zinc buckets; ONE plain envelope; ONE coin; TWO blue aprons on the washing line
environment: workshop yard by day: workbenches, a fence lined with sparrows, a washing line of flapping overalls, cobbles
motion_rule: the hyena walks sideways across the yard every beat, her WHOLE body moving. She fills half the frame height, except the three close-up beats where her face, a bucket or the envelope fills the whole frame. Cuts only at 1.9, 3.6 and 6.6; between them the camera swings round her in one continuous arc, changing angle and shot size.

audio.pacing: first word at 0.3; no words 1.45-1.9, 3.1-3.6, 5.0-5.4; last word by 6.6; after 6.6 the track is rope twang, bucket clatter, the bucket clanking in her jaws, coin clink; her mouth is full of the bucket handle from 6.6
audio.lip_sync: the hyena speaks, jaw working on every syllable
audio.pronunciation: tya-NU za tra-IKH. PLA-tyat za ad-NU. dva-IKH sa-kra-TI-li. CHIS-lyat-sya na MNE

timeline.a: the hyena runs sideways, ripping a tow rope off a bench onto her shoulder; overalls flap in the foreground
hunched, she hauls the rope sideways left to right, three zinc buckets scraping behind
close-up: the rope jerks her into a sideways stumble; the last bucket bounces off a cobble into the lens, filling the frame
trotting sideways, she snatches and tears the envelope from the rat's paw; a coin drops in the dust
close-up: still trotting, she waves the torn empty envelope into the lens, paper filling the frame
walking sideways, she rips off two blue aprons and flings them over her shoulders; overalls flap in the foreground
the rat yanks the apron ties tight behind her back; she lurches sideways, eyes bulging, tongue out
in three aprons, she drags the rope sideways, buckets grinding behind; the rat scrabbles for the coin in the foreground
the rope snaps, twang; still walking, she bites the handle of a rolling bucket, clank; two buckets clatter through the foreground
she scuttles sideways, the bucket in her jaws banging her chest; the rat in the foreground lifts the coin and bites it
walking sideways, she kicks a fallen bucket ahead over the cobbles, crash; sparrows burst off the fence
timeline.c: arc goes on, low and close
